name: Invoicepress
author: Fahad Mahmood

sections.description:
Invoicepress is a powerful and flexible invoicing solution for WordPress and WooCommerce. Easily create, manage, and download professional invoices in PDF format for orders, quotations, or billing purposes.

Key Features:

  • Generate PDF invoices for any order or transaction
  • WooCommerce-compatible: adds “Download Invoice” on My Account page
  • Easy-to-use invoice builder under WP Admin
  • Customize invoice layout and branding
  • Attach invoices to customer emails
  • Download, print, or share invoices with a single click
  • Multi-language support with translation-ready strings
  • GDPR-friendly – no sensitive data stored unnecessarily

Author: Fahad Mahmood
Plugin Site: https://www.invoicepress.com

sections.installation:
To install Invoicepress, you will need:

  • A working WordPress installation (version 5.0 or later)
  • Admin access to install plugins

Method A: Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Click Upload Plugin, choose the ZIP file, and hit Install Now
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Visit Settings → Invoicepress or WooCommerce → Invoicepress (if WooCommerce is active)

Method B: Manual Installation

  1. Download the Invoicepress ZIP and extract it on your computer
  2. Upload the folder invoicepress to /wp-content/plugins/ using FTP/SFTP
  3. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins
  4. Access Invoicepress from Settings or WooCommerce menu
sections.faq:
Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes, fully. It adds a download invoice button in your customer’s My Account page.

Can I customize the PDF layout?

Absolutely. You can modify the HTML template, logo, currency, and layout.

Does it support multi-language?

Yes. All strings are translatable and .pot file is included.

Where are invoices saved?

Invoices are stored securely in the uploads/invoicepress/ directory.

Can I automatically delete old invoices?

Yes. You can schedule auto-cleanups based on age and file type.
